ligula.definition:
n. See Ligule.
n. The central process, or front edge, of the labium of
   insects. It sometimes serves as a tongue or proboscis, as in bees.
n. A tongue-shaped lobe of the parapodia of annelids. See
   Parapodium.

ligulae.translation: n. （昆虫的）唇舌( ligula的名词复数 )

ligularia.definition: n genus of Old World herbs resembling groundsel: leopard plants

ligulas.translation: n. （昆虫的）唇舌( ligula的名词复数 )

ligulated.definition:
a. Like a bandage, or strap; strap-shaped.
a. Composed of ligules.
ligulated.translation: a. 舌叶的；有舌叶的；有舌状器官的；舌状的；带状的

ligule.definition: n. (botany) any appendage to a plant that is shaped like a strap
ligule.translation:
n. 舌叶, 舌状
[医] 第四脑室带

liguliflorous.definition:
a. Bearing only ligulate flowers; -- said of a large
   suborder of composite plants, such as the dandelion, lettuce, hawkweed,
   etc.

liguori.translation: abbr. Liguori Publications 利古力出版社

ligure.definition: n. A kind of precious stone.
ligure.translation: n. 紫玛瑙(古时犹太教高级教士法衣上所镶十二颗宝石之一,见《圣经·出埃及记》)

ligures.definition:
plural of ligure
n. A kind of precious stone.
ligures.translation: (ligure 的复数) n.紫玛瑙(古时犹太教高级教士法衣上所镶十二颗宝石之一,见《圣经·出埃及记》)

liguria.definition: n. region of northwestern Italy on the Ligurian Sea
liguria.translation: 利古里亚区[意大利行政区名]

ligurian.translation:
n. 利古里亚人, 意大利土语
a. 利古里亚人[语]的

ligurian sea.translation: 利古里亚海（地中海北部的一个海域）

ligurians.translation:
(Ligurian 的复数) n.利古里亚人, 意大利土语
a. 利古里亚人[语]的

ligusticum brachylobum.translation: [医] 短叶藁本, 川防风

ligustrin.definition:
n. A bitter principle found in the bark of the privet
   (Ligustrum vulgare), and extracted as a white crystalline substance
   with a warm, bitter taste; -- called also ligustron.

ligustrum.definition: n. genus of Old World shrubs: privet

ligustrum obtusifolium.translation: [网络] 辽东水蜡；辽东水腊树；水蜡树

ligustrum vulgare.translation: [网络] 普通女贞；女贞属；女贞树
